    Model evidence for an mPPI fit

    mppi_evidence.Rd

    Summarises information-criteria support for the multivariate PPI model versus a task-only baseline, leveraging quantities stored by mppi_fit().

    mppi_evidence(fit, aggregate = TRUE)

    Arguments

    fit

    An object returned by mppi_fit() or a higher-level wrapper.

    aggregate

    Logical; when TRUE (default) the aggregate totals are returned alongside per-component statistics.

    Value

    When aggregate = TRUE a list with elements per_column (data frame with component-wise RSS, AIC/BIC, and deltas) and aggregate (one-row data frame of totals). When aggregate = FALSE only the per-component data frame is returned.

    Details

    The statistics are computed from the residual sum-of-squares of the full design (confounds plus psychological regressors) and the baseline design (confounds only). Positive deltas indicate that the PPI-inclusive model improves the evidence relative to the baseline.

    Author

    multiPPI developers

    See also

    mppi_fit, mppi_hrf_ensemble

    Examples

    set.seed(1)
Y <- matrix(rnorm(200), 100, 2)
X <- cbind(1, rnorm(100), rnorm(100))
fit <- mppi_fit(Y, X, psych_idx = 3)
ev <- mppi_evidence(fit)
head(ev$per_column)
#>    component rss_full rss_base   AIC_full   AIC_base delta_AIC  BIC_full
#> 1 component1 79.61981 79.84246 -16.790727 -18.511476 -1.720749 -8.975217
#> 2 component2 90.35511 90.61280  -4.142261  -5.857467 -1.715206  3.673249
#>      BIC_base delta_BIC
#> 1 -13.3011357 -4.325919
#> 2  -0.6471266 -4.320376
